note_en: 除了…还… means "besides…, also…": 除了喝茶，这里还能吃到各种点心 "Besides tea, you can also have all kinds of dim sum here." With 还 (or 也) the 除了 phrase is included, like "in addition to"; with 都 instead (除了…都…) it is excluded, like "except for," so the adverb after the comma decides the meaning.
